text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross is a pint-sized Umamusume hailing from Naniwa. Despite her underprivileged beginnings, she strives to succeed for the sake of her family. Together, we're about to take on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We try our hand at a scrimmage first, but although she prides herself on her final-stretch sprinting—also the source of her "White Lightning" nickname—she struggles to break through the pack of bigger racers…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's upset by her loss, but as always, the kindhearted Super Creek is there to smother her with reassurance and love.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Tamamo Cross rebuffs her coddling, demanding to be treated like an adult. She dashes off, and our race to save her family from poverty begins!
